{{Quote|Chu-Gon Dar was a Jedi Master that lived thousands of years ago during the era of the Old Republic. He resided at the Jedi Temple here on Mustafar and his knowledge and understanding of the Physical Force was unmatched by any other.|[[Ithes Olok]]|<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Lost%20Treasure&resource=features|text=Lost Treasure}}</ref>}}
The '''Physical Force''' was a facet of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that allowed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to manipulate objects in their surroundings. Such acts required the use of the [[Force power/Legends#Alter|Alter]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] discipline, to which the Physical Force was connected in concept. The Physical Force complemented the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] and the [[Unifying Force/Legends|Unifying Force]]. These three plus the [[Cosmic Force/Legends|Cosmic Force]] were the four primary aspects of the Force.
